name: i-have-adhd
description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
one_liner: A free add-on that trains your AI coding assistant to answer with the action first and the chit-chat cut, instead of burying the fix in a paragraph of preamble.
buyer: There isn't really a buyer here — it's a free personal-productivity tweak an individual developer installs for themselves, not something a company would purchase.
business_use_cases: N/A — this is a personality tweak for a coding agent, not a system a business builds a workflow around.
An internal tools team at a software company could adapt the same 10 rules into their own house style guide for AI-generated code review comments, but that's an internal habit, not a product.

money_ideas.idea: None realistic — it's a single markdown-style rules file; there's no packaging, support burden, or differentiation that would justify a paid product.

steal_this: Nothing to build here — the entire value is a well-written prompt file you can just read and copy the ideas from directly.
